svg.text: Two hardware platforms, one Platform object
How DeepInfer picks NVIDIA or Ascend at start-up, and what the choice sets · commit 9bd9cf2
Which platform? The device files decide
deep_cluster looks for device files. It does not import torch. get_platform() turns the answer into one object.
deepinfer.PLATFORM → calls it on first use
What does each Platform object set?
Both classes fill the same names. Shared code reads PLATFORM.<name>; some code also checks PLATFORM.is_npu.
constructor also changes the process (see below)
The NCCL SM limit comes from the env var
Ascend only: extra start-up steps in __init__
Simplified: the NCCL option names are config.max_ctas and config.min_ctas (platform.py:80-82). HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=240 and HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=200 are defaults
(setdefault); HCCL_BUFFSIZE=16, PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF and TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=0 always overwrite. Step 1 raises RuntimeError when CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is
Not shown: TORCH_NPU_DEVICE_CAPABILITY=9.0 (a temporary torch_npu work-around, platform.py:117-118) and set_compile_mode(jit_compile=False).
